meta.task: Markdown 表格 → 建表 DDL · 浏览器端到端验证

assertions.name: convert-md-ddl 在左栏可见
assertions.actual: true

assertions.name: JTCore.mdddl 已加载
assertions.actual: true

assertions.name: 参数标签顺序正确
assertions.expected: Markdown 表格|方言|表名|主键字段名|含字段注释|字段命名风格
assertions.actual: ["Markdown 表格","方言","表名","主键字段名","含字段注释","字段命名风格"]

assertions.name: 参数类型正确
assertions.actual: ["textarea","select","text","text","checkbox","select"]

assertions.name: 默认值：方言 mysql / withComments true / nameStyle camel
assertions.actual:
["| 英文名称 | 类型 | 最大长度 | 是否非空 | 参数说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| user_name | varchar | 64 | 是 | 用户登录名 |
| age | int |  | 否 | 年龄 |","mysql","my_table","","true","camel"]

assertions.name: 无错误条
assertions.actual: {"visible":false,"text":"","status":"执行成功 · 输出 127 字符"}

assertions.name: MySQL 头注释
反引号 CREATE TABLE
VARCHAR(64) + NOT NULL + 行尾注释
assertions.expected: `user_name` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL  -- 用户登录名

assertions.name: age 为 INT 且可空
Oracle 头注释
双引号 CREATE TABLE
VARCHAR2 列 + NOT NULL
COMMENT ON COLUMN 语句
assertions.expected: COMMENT ON COLUMN "t_user"."user_name" IS 用户登录名

assertions.name: PG 头注释
双引号列
单引号转义为两个
camel → `userName`
snake → `user_name`
upper_snake → `USER_NAME`
pascal → `UserName`
keep → `user_name`
勾选时有行尾注释
取消后无注释
主键跨风格标记
仅标一次
name/type/length/not null/comment 表头产出 DDL
assertions.expected: email VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL 且无错误

assertions.name: 位置回退产出 DDL
位置回退 notice
assertions.actual: ["表头列「A」未能识别，已忽略","表头列「B」未能识别，已忽略","表头列「C」未能识别，已忽略","表头列「D」未能识别，已忽略","表头列「E」未能识别，已忽略","表头未识别出「英文名称」与「类型」，已按 5 列默认顺序（名称/类型/最大长度/非空/说明）解析"]

assertions.name: 无法识别表头显示中文错误条
assertions.expected: 错误条含「无法识别表头」
assertions.actual: {"visible":true,"text":"无法识别表头：至少需要「英文名称」与「类型」两列","status":"无法识别表头：至少需要「英文名称」与「类型」两列"}

assertions.name: 空输入显示中文错误条
assertions.actual: {"visible":true,"text":"输入为空：请粘贴 Markdown 表格","status":"输入为空：请粘贴 Markdown 表格"}

assertions.name: 截图前 Oracle DDL 正常
